ONLYBODY + ONLYWEIGHTS

Privacy Policy

Your workouts stay on your device. Here is what happens to the rest.

Last updated: 3 November 2026

ON THIS PAGE

On your device Exercise videos Website and support Deleting data Your rights and contact

This policy covers OnlyBody, OnlyWeights and onlybody.app. I’m Illia Khvost, the developer and controller of personal information I receive. Contact: support@onlybody.app.

On your device

No account. No upload of your training history. Each app stores your workouts, sets, reps, weights, history and settings on your device. I cannot access these records remotely. The apps have no analytics or advertising SDKs and do not access Apple Health.

Optional reminders use local iOS notifications, with your permission. You can turn them off in iOS Settings.

Your device backups may include app data. Apple manages backups and any diagnostics you choose to share under its Privacy Policy. I may use shared crash reports to fix problems.

Exercise videos

Demonstrations use the official YouTube player and YouTube API Services. Opening an exercise with a video connects to Google, even before you press Play. Google receives your IP address, device information and video activity, and may use cookies or similar identifiers for playback, security, measurement and ads. Your workout records are not sent to YouTube.

Google handles this information under its Privacy Policy. See also the YouTube Terms and Google privacy controls. The apps do not request access to your Google account.

Website and support

This website has no analytics, advertising scripts or embedded videos. Cloudflare hosts and protects it, processing technical request data such as IP addresses, page requests and browser information.

If you email me, I use your email address, message and attachments to answer your request. Email providers deliver and store that correspondence. I do not sell your information or use support emails for marketing.

For information I handle, the legal bases are providing services you request, legitimate interests in support, security and fixing faults, and meeting legal obligations. Hosting, email and diagnostic providers process data as described above; information may also be disclosed when legally required.

Providers may process data outside the EEA, including in the US. Their policies describe transfer safeguards, such as adequacy decisions or standard contractual clauses. Contact me for details of safeguards for information I control.

Deleting data

To remove all local records, use iOS Delete App. Offload App keeps them. Manage backups separately. Deleting a workout template does not delete completed history.

Support messages are kept only as long as needed for your request and follow-up, unless legal requirements or a dispute require longer retention. Provider records follow their own policies; deleting an app does not erase data already received by Google or other providers.

Your rights and contact

For information I hold, you can request access, a copy, correction or deletion. Depending on applicable law, you may also request portability or restricted processing, object to processing, or withdraw consent where it is the legal basis.

Write to support@onlybody.app. I normally respond within one month and may need to verify your identity. You can complain to UODO or your local data-protection authority.

The apps are not designed specifically for children. Contact me if a child sends personal information so I can review and, where appropriate, delete it.

I will update this page and its date when practices change, and provide notice of material changes.
